row.team_price_text: Lite: $1,290/yr (~$108/mo) annual or $129/mo monthly, 1 user included
row.evidence: Ahrefs' SAML SSO help article says "SAML SSO is available on Enterprise plans" and documents SCIM provisioning in the same article (enabled through Ahrefs support); the pricing page lists SSO only under Enterprise at $1,499/mo with an annual commitment.
row.notes: Status unchanged from June (gated, Enterprise). SCIM is not named on the pricing page; it is documented in the SAML SSO help article, which says SAML is Enterprise-only and SCIM is switched on by Ahrefs support per IdP, so the SCIM plan is inferred from the SSO gate (confidence medium). Enterprise $1,499/mo with annual commitment and 'From 3' included users, unchanged. Plans are flat per workspace with 1 user included (Lite/Standard/Advanced) plus paid extra seats ($40/$60/$80/mo), so per-user fields are null; June's per-user 129 was the Lite monthly price and is dropped. Annual Lite is $1,290/yr (shown after the 'Pay annually' toggle). Starter ($29/mo) is cheaper but cannot add users, so Lite stays the team plan. JIT is marked 'coming soon'. No IdP catalogue app provisions: Okta lists only an SWA app (Ahrefs Link Manager). The Ahrefs API v3 covers SEO data and project management only; no user-management endpoints.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.price_text: $1,499/mo, annual commitment required; from 3 users, extra users $100/mo each
plans.notes: Pricing page lists 'Access management & audit log' (UI); no audit-log API is documented.

operations.notes: Docs say assigned users are added and unassigned users are removed from the workspace; nothing more.

limitations.text: SCIM is not self-serve: Ahrefs support enables it for the customer's IdP.
API v3 is an SEO-data API; its 'Management' group manages Rank Tracker projects and Keywords Explorer lists, not users or members.

user_api.notes: available=false because the API introduction enumerates every endpoint group (Site Explorer, Keywords Explorer, Site Audit, Rank Tracker, SERP Overview, Batch Analysis, Brand Radar, Social Media, Content Helper, Management, Subscription info, Public) and none manages users.

okta.notes: OIN search returns one app, 'Ahrefs Link Manager', tagged SWA only.

entra.notes: No Entra gallery tutorial found (ahrefs-tutorial and ahrefs-provisioning-tutorial on learn.microsoft.com return 404).

fallbacks.notes: The SAML article lists JIT provisioning as 'coming soon'. Members are otherwise invited by email.
